author: marlon-chaviano
name: saas-t3
title: SaaS with the T3 stack
description: create-t3-app: Next.js with tRPC for an end-to-end typed API, Drizzle, Better Auth and Tailwind CSS. The go-to stack for TypeScript SaaS.

base.command: npx -y create-t3-app@latest {{name}} --CI --tailwind --trpc --drizzle --betterAuth --appRouter --dbProvider postgres --noGit --noInstall && cd {{name}} && npm pkg set devDependencies.drizzle-kit=^0.31.4 dependencies.drizzle-orm=^0.45.2 && npm pkg delete packageManager

instructions:
## How to work here

- The API is tRPC routers in `src/server/api/routers/`, registered in `src/server/api/root.ts`. Use `protectedProcedure` for anything that needs a session.
- Environment variables are validated in `src/env.js`: add every new variable there.
- The database schema is in `src/server/db/schema.ts`; apply changes with `npm run db:push` (or `db:generate` + `db:migrate`).
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
